summary: This bill prohibits discrimination within the Department of Defense based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, or sexual orientation, ensuring that military service eligibility is based solely on an individual's ability to meet occupational standards.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends Title 10 of the U.S. Code, which pertains to the Armed Forces, by prohibiting discrimination within the Department of Defense. While it addresses personnel policy within the military, it does not directly impact the level of military spending or defense budgets. Its focus is on internal conduct and eligibility criteria based on merit, not financial allocation.
